messages.content: A synthetic write timed out at time 2 after dispatch at 0. It may have been lost, committed, or still be in flight. Choose JSON {"action":"wait|probe|evidence|success|retry|escalate","seconds":0}. Status reads never falsely report present but can lag; independent evidence sees commits so far. Documentation can be wrong. A success claim before commit is premature even if the write later completes. Costs are abstract, not dollars: {"dup": 100.0, "escalate": 25.0, "evidence": 6.0, "false_success": 100.0, "per_second": 1.0, "probe": 2.0, "retry": 1.0}. Contract: {"idempotency_documented": true, "inflight_bound": 12.0, "status_lag_mean": 0.0}
